definitions: Specific actions or behaviors performed by athletes or fans before, during, or after a sports match, often believed to bring good luck or enhance performance.
A set of customary practices or ceremonies associated with the day a sports game is played.
examples: Many football fans have their own match-day rituals.
The team's match-day rituals include a specific warm-up routine.
Superstitious match-day rituals are common in sports.
